requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the condition relevance scoring logic from EVAL-CT-M3-S2 within the clinical trial evaluation pipeline.
The system must include a relevance_score field (0 to 1) in the clinical trial evaluation output returned by the facade.
The system must include matched_terms in the evaluation output when at least one condition match is found.
The system must include a match_type field (exact, partial, semantic, none) in the evaluation output.
The system must include a human-readable explanation string describing how the relevance score was derived.
The system must propagate relevance scoring results through evaluate_care_facade.py without altering unrelated evaluation fields.
The system must ensure the explanation references the user’s input condition terms or their normalized equivalents.
The system must ensure the explanation differentiates between exact, partial, and semantic matches in natural language.
The system must ensure the explanation length does not exceed a predefined maximum suitable for chat responses.
The system must return a relevance_score of 0 and match_type 'none' when no condition overlap or similarity is detected.
The system must handle null or empty user condition input by returning a relevance_score of 0 and an explanation indicating missing input.
The system must handle missing or empty trial condition data by returning a relevance_score of 0 and an explanation indicating unavailable trial condition data.
The system must ensure the output structure is serializable and compatible with existing API response schemas used by the facade.
The system must ensure the explanation avoids medical claims and only describes matching logic between user conditions and trial conditions.
The system must ensure deterministic output for identical inputs (same user condition and trial data produce identical score and explanation).
